Whether you’re booking your first charter or a seasoned angler, knowing how to prepare can make the difference between a frustrating day and a successful fishing adventure. In this guide, we’ll provide essential tips to ensure your fishing trip in Boston Harbor is smooth, enjoyable, and productive. blurb: Guests join private fishing charters led by experienced captains with over 40 years of local knowledge. Trips include hands-on fishing using various techniques like bottom fishing, trolling, drifting, and light tackle casting. The experience is customized to the group's skill level and includes live bait, catch cleaning and filleting, and all necessary gear.
